findings.title: parseFormData rework and formData cache have no ordering/reuse tests
findings.why_it_matters: parseFormData now reads arrayBuffer() instead of formData(). When a handler calls `await c.req.formData()` before `c.req.parseBody()`, HonoRequest.#cachedBody('arrayBuffer') finds only the `formData` cache key and rebuilds bytes via `new Response(formData).arrayBuffer()`. That produces a fresh multipart boundary that does not match the original Content-Type header. For multipart this makes parseBody throw 'Failed to parse body as FormData'. For urlencoded it silently returns garbage keys. Before this diff the same sequence worked because parseBody called the cached formData(). No test covers formData()-then-parseBody(), parseBody() twice, or that bodyCache.formData is populated and reused, so the regression is invisible. The added tests all use a fresh request per case.
findings.suggested_fix: Add tests in src/request.test.ts (req.parseBody()) and src/utils/body.test.ts: (1) HonoRequest with multipart and urlencoded bodies, `await req.formData()` then `await req.parseBody()`, asserting the parsed values; (2) `parseBody` called twice on one HonoRequest; (3) parseBody then `req.formData()` returns the cached instance. Then fix parseFormData to reuse `request.bodyCache.formData` when it is already set, mirroring the guard in src/validator/validator.ts lines 115-116, before calling arrayBuffer().
evidence: src/utils/body.ts:126 -- const arrayBuffer = await (request as Request).arrayBuffer()
src/request.ts:228-234 -- const anyCachedKey = Object.keys(bodyCache)[0]; if (anyCachedKey) { return (bodyCache[anyCachedKey]).then((body) => { ... return new Response(body)[key]() }) }

Scratch simulation in node: formData parsed from multipart, re-serialized with new Response(formData).arrayBuffer(), reparsed with the original Content-Type -> 'Failed to parse body as FormData.'; urlencoded variant returns a single garbage entry.
Existing tests src/request.test.ts:351-360 and 367-383 only exercise formData() and parseBody() on separate fresh requests; grep finds no test combining them.

residual_risks: Content-Type edge shapes for the new media-type extraction are untested: leading/trailing whitespace before ';' (the `.trim()` in parseBody) and a missing or empty Content-Type header reaching parseFormData with `|| ''`.

The validator json path has a mixed-case test only for a bare 'Application/JSON'. The regex /i flag also newly accepts mixed-case suffix types such as 'Application/Vnd.API+JSON' and mixed-case parameter names, which have no tests.
testing_gaps: No negative test that a mixed-case non-form media type (for example 'Text/Plain' or 'Application/Json' on parseBody) still returns {} from parseBody.
